function.name: lsp
function.description: Ask a local language server for diagnostics or symbol references, or perform an approval-gated workspace rename. Paths stay inside the project. Diagnostics and references are read-only. Before rename, collect references/read every affected file and pass their current content hashes in expected_files; an unlisted or stale file makes the whole rename fail without writing.

path.description: Rust or C/C++ file relative to the project root.

line.description: 1-based line containing the symbol. Required for references and rename.

column.description: 1-based Unicode-character column at the symbol. Required for references and rename.

new_name.description: New symbol name. Required for rename; max 128 characters with no whitespace.

expected_files.description: For rename, every file the server may edit with its latest 8-hex content_hash from read/references.

include_declaration.description: Include the declaration in references. Default true.
